rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a note at the bottom of a page and, figuratively, something treated as a minor detail in history.

example.english: There is a footnote at the bottom of this page explaining the source of the term.
example.traditional: 呢頁最下面有個註腳，解釋咗呢個術語嘅來源。
example.jyutping: ne1 jip6 zeoi3 haa6 min6 jau5 go3 zyu3 goek3 gaai2 sik1 zo2 ni1 go3 seot6 jyu5 ge3 loi4 jyun4

rows.note: Use this for a condition or caveat attached to what someone says or means.

example.english: I agree to help you, but my agreement comes with one footnote: you have to clean up yourself.
example.traditional: 我同意幫你，但有一個附帶條件：你要自己負責清理。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 ji3 bong1 nei5 daan6 jau5 jat1 go3 fu6 daai3 tiu4 gin2 nei5 jiu3 zi6 gei2 fu6 zaak3 cing1 lei5
